name: TEMPTING FATE: CHASING HIGHS
source:
Two girls play a deadly game, only one of them can leave the room alive. Maybe they'll kiss about it along the way? Nothing could possibly go awry!

[From [url=https://intothesinx.itch.io/tempting-fate-chasing-highs]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两个女孩玩着一场致命的游戏，只有一个人能活着离开房间。也许他们会一路上接吻？一切都不可能出错！

[来自[url=https://intothesinx.itch.io/tempting-fate-chasing-highs]itch.io[/url]]
